def analyze_play(data):
    """Continuous counters are not a paired speed or all-game correctness test."""
    r=data.get('resource_reuse',{});c=r.get('total',{});errors=[]
    def check(ok,msg):
        if not ok:errors.append(msg)
    def integer(v):return type(v) is int and 0<=v<2**64
    check(data.get('capture_plan')=='resource-reuse-play-1' and r.get('version')==1,'Wrong normal-play schema')
    check(r.get('continuous') is True and r.get('first_reuse_requires_full_audit') is True
          and r.get('GPU_write_sources_reused') is False and r.get('scene_memo')=='original','Wrong normal-play authority')
    check(data.get('controls_complete') is True and data.get('tests_dropped')==0,'Controls missing or failed')
    check(all(t.get('status') in ('pass','skip') for t in data.get('tests',[])),'Automatic control failure')
    check(sum(t.get('suite')=='resource_reuse' and t.get('name')=='dynamic_core' and t.get('status')=='pass'
              for t in data.get('tests',[]))==1,'Missing/duplicate private control')
    check(all(type(r.get(k)) is bool for k in ('started','stopped','failed')),'Invalid state flags')
    check(all(integer(r.get(k)) for k in ('frames','refresh_checks','blockers')),'Invalid session counters')
    valid=all(integer(c.get(k)) for k in FIELDS)
    check(valid,'Invalid work counters')
    if valid:
        check(c['calls']==c['reference_calls']+c['reused_calls'],'Calls do not reconcile')
        check(c['audits']<=c['reference_calls'] and c['audit_bytes']<=c['reference_bytes'],'Invalid audits')
        check(not c['reused_calls'] or c['audits']>0,'Reuse without an audit')
        check(not c['mismatches'] and not c['exceptions'] and r.get('failed') is False,'Mismatch or runtime failure')
        fb=c.get('fallback',[])
        check(len(fb)==len(FALLBACK) and all(integer(x) for x in fb),'Invalid fallback ledger')
        if len(fb)==len(FALLBACK) and all(integer(x) for x in fb):
            check(fb[0]==0 and fb[8]==c['raced_hashes'] and c['raced_hashes']<=c['reference_calls']
                  and sum(fb)-fb[8]<=c['reference_calls'],'Fallback ledger does not reconcile')
        v=c.get('version_fields',[])
        check(len(v)==9 and all(integer(x) for x in v),'Invalid version fields')
        if len(v)==9 and all(integer(x) for x in v) and len(fb)==len(FALLBACK):
            check(all(x<=fb[6] for x in v) and sum(v)>=fb[6],'Version-field ledger mismatch')
        ex=r.get('counterexamples',[]);d=r.get('counterexamples_dropped')
        check(isinstance(ex,list) and integer(d) and len(ex)+d==c['mismatches'],'Counterexample mismatch')
    policy=r.get('source_policy',{})
    check(policy.get('GPU_writers_reused') is False and policy.get('veto_release')=='session_end_only','Invalid source exclusions')
    return dict(capture_plan='resource-reuse-play-1',evidence_valid=not errors,comparison_eligible=False,comparison=None,
        actual_work=c,source_policy=policy,stopped=r.get('stopped'),blockers=r.get('blockers'),exclusions=errors,
        warnings=['Continuous normal play has no STOCK/REUSE timing comparison; do not infer a speedup.',
                  'Entry audits are per-resource admission, not periodic detection of arbitrary untracked writers.',
                  'Counters cover active cache evaluation, not full-reference work after session fallback.',
                  'Dynamic game-wide correctness and normal-play net benefit are not established by the earlier fixed-scene capture.'])

def analyze(data):
    if data.get("capture_plan")=="resource-reuse-play-1":return analyze_play(data)
